verdict.rationale: Cooley GO offers public document generators that cover every document type in the story. The Delaware incorporation package includes the certificate, bylaws, RSPA with IP assignment and 83(b) forms. There is a generator labeled "Free" for multiple YC Safe versions, a Series Seed package that includes a term sheet, and an NDA form. A Hacker News user independently describes it as a great resource of templates and generators for startups. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that no client relationship or registration is required, and NDA coverage beyond the single UK mutual form shown.
